name: vibedev_rail_project_context_plan
content: - Discuss runs call run_coding_task once with plan_only: true before any other inspection; the coding engine only reads the project and writes the plan.
- Success = run_coding_task returned a plan. A Discuss run stages no proposal and changes no file.

metadata.description: Discuss-only half of the `@vibedev` chat rail's project-context guidance, rendered above the mode-neutral vibedev_rail_project_context prose for a `#discuss` (plan) run and never for a build run. Its build counterpart is vibedev_rail_project_context_build; the plan run's full directive follows in vibedev_rail_plan_directive.
metadata.author: magician
